## Meta launches first-ever consumer AI agent subscription at $20 and $100 per month tiers

Meta's first consumer AI subscription tier is a potential new recurring revenue stream that could expand its non-advertising revenue mix; at the $20/$100 price points, even modest adoption at scale could materially supplement ad revenue and reframe how the market credits Meta's AI investments.

- Meta is charging consumers for a personal AI agent for the first time, with published price tiers at $20/month and $100/month.
- The Globe and Mail headline explicitly frames the story around revenue addition potential, making this an investor-oriented monetization narrative.
- This marks a new business model for Meta — direct AI subscription revenue alongside its core advertising business.
- Headline does not specify feature differentiation between tiers, launch geography, or initial subscriber expectations.
